text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Heat map: share of the physics core's total excess over XGBoost in each cell (orange: larger). Line: mean excess per half-hour in each speed bin. Every half-hour of November 2019 to June 2025 scored out of sample, with each July-to-June year held out in turn. Excess is the core's quantile score minus XGBoost's; positive means XGBoost is better. W1 to W3.'
text.tspan: Heat map: share of the physics core's total excess over XGBoost in each cell (orange: larger).
Line: mean excess per half-hour in each speed bin. Every half-hour of November 2019 to June
2025 scored out of sample, with each July-to-June year held out in turn. Excess is the core's
quantile score minus XGBoost's; positive means XGBoost is better. W1 to W3.
